mapper.select: SELECT CASE #{statisticsType} WHEN 'AVG' THEN AVG(smoke_concentration) AS avg_smoke, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature, AVG(battery_level) AS avg_battery WHEN 'MAX' THEN MAX(smoke_concentration) AS max_smoke, MAX(temperature) AS max_temperature, MAX(battery_level) AS max_battery WHEN 'MIN' THEN MIN(smoke_concentration) AS min_smoke, MIN(temperature) AS min_temperature, MIN(battery_level) AS min_battery ELSE AVG(smoke_concentration) AS avg_smoke, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature, AVG(battery_level) AS avg_battery END FROM sensor_data_log WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
SELECT * FROM sensor_data_log WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} ORDER BY collection_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(collection_time) AS date, AVG(smoke_concentration) AS avg_smoke, MAX(smoke_concentration) AS max_smoke, MIN(smoke_concentration) AS min_smoke, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature, MAX(temperature) AS max_temperature, MIN(temperature) AS min_temperature, COUNT(*) AS data_count FROM sensor_data_log WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(collection_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_alarm, SUM(CASE WHEN smoke_concentration > 5.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smoke_alarm, SUM(CASE WHEN temperature > 60.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS temperature_alarm FROM sensor_data_log WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
